stem.en: What does the mother's behaviour in the first paragraph suggest?

options.en: Facing the bench after her husband's death was too painful for her
She was waiting for her son abroad to come and sort out the garage
She had never liked the hours her husband spent at the bench
She thought the bench should have been sold long ago

why.en: After the father died, the bench became “a problem that nobody would name”, and the mother passed it every morning without looking at it: she was avoiding a painful reminder. The son abroad expected the family at home to deal with the garage, not himself, and nothing suggests she disliked the hobby or wanted to sell the bench.
why.uz: Ota vafot etgach, ish dastgohi «hech kim nomini tilga olmaydigan muammo»ga aylangan, ona esa har kuni ertalab uning yonidan qaramay oʻtgan: u ogʻriqli xotiradan qochgan. Chet eldagi oʻgʻli garaj bilan uydagilar shugʻullanishini kutgan, oʻzi emas; onaning erining mashgʻulotini yoqtirmagani yoki dastgohni sotmoqchi boʻlgani haqida hech qanday ishora yoʻq.
why.ru: После смерти отца верстак стал «проблемой, которую никто не называл вслух», а мать каждое утро проходила мимо, не глядя на него: она избегала болезненного напоминания. Брат за границей ждал, что с гаражом разберутся домашние, а не он сам, и ничто не говорит о том, что мать не любила увлечение мужа или хотела продать верстак.

stem.en: In the fourth paragraph, what does “joint” mean?

options.en: A place where two pieces of wood fit together
A place in the body where two bones meet and move
A large piece of meat for roasting
A cheap bar or café

why.en: The neighbour looks at the chair leg clamped in the vice and says “He was cutting a joint”: the place where the leg would be fitted to another part of the chair. This is woodwork, so bones, meat and cafés do not fit.
why.uz: Qoʻshni iskanjaga qisilgan stul oyogʻiga qarab, «U ulanish joyini kesayotgan ekan», deydi: oyoq stulning boshqa qismiga biriktiriladigan joy. Bu duradgorlik ishi, shuning uchun suyak boʻgʻimi, goʻsht boʻlagi yoki arzon kafe mos kelmaydi.
why.ru: Сосед смотрит на ножку стула, зажатую в тисках, и говорит: «He was cutting a joint», то есть вырезал соединение — место, где ножка крепится к другой детали стула. Это столярная работа, поэтому сустав, кусок мяса для жарки и дешёвое кафе не подходят.
